_meta.purpose: Compliance-by-design guardrails for the AI credit-repair + funding GUIDANCE product. Education/guidance only — not legal/financial advice, not a lender/credit-repair-org unless properly registered.

prohibited_claims._note: The AI must NEVER produce these. CROA/FTC bar false or guaranteed-result claims; some patterns are outright illegal.

required_disclosures._note: At least these must appear in any consumer-facing credit/funding output or be present in the wrapping UI/contract.
general: This is educational guidance, not legal or financial advice.
Results vary and no specific outcome is guaranteed.
credit_repair_CROA: You have the right to dispute inaccurate information in your own credit report for free.
You may cancel this contract within 3 business days at no charge.
We do not charge for credit-repair services before they are performed.
funding: We are not a lender or loan broker unless separately licensed in your state.
This is not an offer of securities or investment, and not a guarantee of funding.

fee_rules._note: CROA + FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule: NO advance fees for credit repair.

ai_may: Educate on how credit scoring, reports, and funding readiness work.
Help a user identify and dispute INACCURATE/unverifiable items themselves.
Build budgets, readiness checklists, and document organization.
Explain options and general eligibility in plain language.
ai_must_not: Promise or imply guaranteed deletions, scores, or funding.
Advise removing accurate, current, verifiable information.
Create or suggest CPNs / synthetic identities / new credit files.
File or draft knowingly false or frivolous disputes.
Give legal advice or draft binding legal documents.
Tell a consumer to stop paying lawful debts.
Collect advance fees for credit-repair work not yet performed.

registration_flags._note: Many states require Credit Services Organization registration + a surety bond. Confirm per state with counsel before selling there.

pre_sale_gate._note: Hard prerequisites before charging anyone. Owner backstop — cannot be automated away.
checklist: Fee structure with NO advance fees for credit repair
State CSO registration + surety bond where required
Funding side: lender/broker licensing reviewed; no securities offering without compliance
Privacy/data handling for consumer PII (GLBA/FCRA) reviewed
Banned-claims guardrail (this file) enforced on all consumer-facing output
